# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import json, base64, ssl, urllib.request, urllib.parse
q = urllib.parse.quote
env = {}
for l in open('/root/unitex-finrep/secure/odata_write.env'):
    l = l.strip()
    if l and '=' in l and not l.startswith('#'):
        k, v = l.split('=', 1); env[k.strip()] = v.strip()
auth = 'Basic ' + base64.b64encode(('%s:%s' % (env['ODATA_USER'], env['ODATA_PASS'])).encode()).decode()
BASE = env['ODATA_URL'].rstrip('/')
ctx = ssl.create_default_context()
try: ctx.load_verify_locations('/root/unitex-finrep/secure/odata_cert.pem')
except Exception: pass
def get(path, raw=False):
    r = urllib.request.Request(BASE + path, headers={'Authorization': auth, 'Accept': 'application/json'})
    d = urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=60, context=ctx).read()
    return d.decode('utf-8-sig') if raw else json.loads(d)
